text:
sasha: Quick proposal — introduce a "staged pin" onboarding tier for new models. Goal: make migrations opt-out at GA but give a staged, low-friction path for customers to opt into pinned versions during validation. Need launch gates, bench thresholds, and a rollout runbook. Thoughts?
eli: +1 on staged pins. Engineering notes: we need clear perf/kv-cache expectations per model family. A pinned variant should not increase P95 by >15ms on our typical 256-token profile. Also watch memory pressure for KV cache duplication.
rachel: Draft acceptance gates idea: 1) Functional parity on eval harness (no more than 2% failure delta on golden prompts), 2) Quality sig tests pass (paired-A/B with p<0.05 on our regression suite), 3) Cost delta < +7% tokens cost, 4) P95 latency delta <= +15ms. All must be met to remove "beta pin" label.
jordan: From ops: rollout plan should be canary -> staggered cohort -> wide. Canary criteria: 1% traffic for 24h, then 5% for 48h. Rollback triggers: error rate increase >0.5% absolute, P95 increase >30ms or sustained CPU/GPU load >85% for 30m. Also require health dashboards to have synthetic probe green for 2 consecutive checkpoints.
mina: Customer success POV: customers want migration windows and an escape hatch. Proposal: pinned-by-default only for customers who opt in; for others provide a 90-day grace window with automated migration suggestions and a per-customer rollback toggle in Console. We should bake comms templates (email + in-console banners).
eli: A couple infra flags: we should differentiate "logical pin" vs "hard pin". Logical pin routes traffic to a version but still allows auto-fallback on overload. Hard pin prevents fallback. Default to logical pin unless customer explicitly requests hard pin (enterprise only).
sasha: Good call. Also need to decide on default pin TTL and renewal flow. Suggest default 90 days with auto-renew if no regressions and user hasn't explicitly unpinned. Renewal action should be surfaced in Console and via billing event.
rachel: On benchmarks — we should require a standardized sample of 10k prompts across common tenants + 5 tenant-specific prompts if customer-provided. Add streaming/cold-start buckets: short (<=64), mid (65-512), long (512+). Bench pass must hold across buckets.
jordan: Ops question: does pinning create multi-version stateful endpoints? If so, we need to ensure KV cache warm-up strategy per pinned version to avoid latency cliffs on cutover. Maybe pre-warm KV cache with replayed prefixes during canary.
eli: Agree. Add pre-warm step to canary runbook: replay representative prefixes to the instance set and verify cache hit rate >= 70% before moving to 5% traffic.
mina: For customer incentives: offer 60 days of discounted pins for early adopters, plus migration support for enterprise customers (hand-off from SE). Also provide an "easy revert" migration credit if rollback needed.
sasha: Draft rollout timeline: Week 0-2 spec + comms, Week 3 canary infra ready, Week 4 internal pilot, Week 5 customer pilot cohort, Week 6 GA opt-in with default logical pins. We can adjust but need to lock acceptance gates by EOD Friday.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary deployment window reserved on 1713080000 for staged-pin infra tests.
rachel: Action items: 1) Eli to add KV warm-up and perf deltas to canary runbook, 2) Jordan to codify rollback thresholds into alerting, 3) Mina to draft comms + incentives, 4) Sasha to propose TTL/renewal UX for Console. I'll create a tracker card.
sasha: Thanks — leaving this thread as the single source for acceptance gate comments. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll mark gates as draft-approved and we can start infra work. :thumbsup:
